import parse

# More complex version
fmt = '''letters: {:w}
non-letters: {:W}
whitespace: \"{ :s}\"
digits: {:d}
fixed-point: {:f}
floating-point: {:e}
general numbers: {:g} {:g}
final value: {}'''
data = '''letters: abcdef
non-letters: !@#%\$
whitespace: \"   \t\n\"
digits: 12345
fixed-point: 0.00001
floating-point: NAN
general numbers: 1.1e10 nan
final value: spam'''

r = parse.parse(fmt, data)
print(r)
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
